# PNG regression inputs

Project-owned PNGs generated by generate.py using Python's zlib/chunk handling,
independently of the product codec. Valid RGB/RGBA/Adam7 inputs encode the same
2×2 RGB pixels; alpha is opaque. Negative cases cover transparency, CRC errors,
unsupported color/sample formats, APNG, inflated-data limits and dimensions.
The generator is not a build prerequisite; checks use the committed files.
